entities.name: Johann
entities.description: Human wizard boy from Eldraine, a nervous village boy turned apprentice sorcerer who mastered the hydroloft spell.

entities.name: Gadwick
entities.description: Archmage and sorcerer of Caervelin who took Johann as his apprentice.

entities.name: Caervelin
entities.description: Domain and tower of the sorcerer Gadwick, where Johann's mishap occurred.

events.summary: Johann is chosen to be apprentice to Gadwick.
events.quote: Johann was chosen to be an apprentice to

events.summary: After Gadwick leaves, Johann fails to maintain the tower's mechanisms and unleashes a flood of elementals.
events.quote: He failed and wounded up unleashing a flood of elementals throughout the tower.

events.summary: Johann tries draconic fire and animated furniture against the elementals, and escapes using a hydroloft spell as his home burns.
events.quote: he escaped his home using a hydroloft spell as it was consumed by fire

relations.note: Johann is the apprentice of Gadwick.
relations.quote: He is the apprentice of the archmage Gadwick .

relations.note: Gadwick is the sorcerer of Caervelin.
